title: How the benefit works
intro: Buy extra vacation days, or sell days you will not use.
highlight: You can do this once a year: either buy or sell, not both.

sections.heading: Buying vacation days
paragraphs: You can buy up to 40% of your annual vacation entitlement.
The cost comes out of your salary over 5 monthly payslips.
**You cannot buy in a year in which you sell.**

sections.heading: Selling vacation days
paragraphs: You can sell only after you have used at least 7 vacation days this year.
You can sell up to 20% of your annual entitlement.
You get the payment in your December payslip.
**You cannot sell in a year in which you buy.**

formula.gross: Gross day value = monthly salary / (21.6 x employment %, for example 0.8 for an 80% job).
formula.net: Net day value = gross day value x (100% - tax rate).
